02 — Use cases

Where it lands.

Scenarios across the audiences ZEHNOX serves. Each one is a shape of engagement, not a case study.

  • 01

    A founder commissions a brand documentary that explains, in twelve minutes, why the company exists.

  • 02

    A creator hands over the monthly reels schedule and keeps the channel publishing on cadence.

  • 03

    A conference is covered with a multi-camera crew and cut into a recap film the following week.

  • 04

    A product launch gets a promo made for the three channels it will actually run on.

03 — Our approach

How the work runs.

A genuine sequence: each step is decided before the next begins, with reviewable progress at every stage.

  1. Concept

    The story, the audience, and the outcome the piece must support.

  2. Pre-production

    Script, shot list, locations, talent, schedule.

  3. Production

    A crew sized for the job, with direction on set.

  4. Post

    Edit, sound, grade, and delivery in every format the channel needs.

05 — FAQ

The questions asked first.

Do you work outside Mirpur?

Yes. Crews travel across Pakistan, and remote production direction and post-production are routine for international clients.

Who owns the footage?

You do. Raw footage and project files are delivered or archived according to the engagement terms.
